map.输入材料类型与工况条件，综合评估可回收性评分、预计使用寿命与环境适配度: Enter material type and service conditions to comprehensively assess recyclability score, expected service life and environmental fit
map.可回收材料评估：基于材料类型、使用温度/载荷/腐蚀环境与年使用时间，参照回收与耐: Recyclable material assessment: based on material type, service temperature / load / corrosion environment and annual usage time, with reference to recycling and durability standards, comprehensively determine recyclability and service applicability for green material decisions.
map.💡 可回收评分=回收率×再生品质×经济性；预计寿命=基准寿命×温度因子×载荷因子: Recycling score = recovery rate times regeneration quality times economy; expected life = base life times temperature factor times load factor times corrosion factor
map.金属回收率>90%，塑料约60%，复合材料<30%: Metal recovery rate greater than 90%, plastic about 60%, composite less than 30%
map.腐蚀环境显著缩短材料寿命，需考虑防护措施: Corrosion environment significantly shortens material life; protection measures should be considered
map.可回收评分综合考虑回收率、再生品质与经济性: Recycling score comprehensively considers recovery rate, regeneration quality and economy
map.📚 深度解析：可回收材料评估（回收性/寿命/环境适配）: In-depth: Recyclable Material Assessment (recyclability / life / environmental fit)
map.绿色设计选材：按回收率、再生质量与经济性评可回收分: Green design material selection: score recyclability by recovery rate, regeneration quality and economy
map.寿命预估：结合温度、载荷、腐蚀与使用强度估算使用年限: Life estimation: estimate service years combining temperature, load, corrosion and usage intensity
map.材料替代：对比碳钢与不锈钢等方案的综合分: Material substitution: compare carbon steel and stainless steel schemes by composite score
map.算法：可回收评分 = 回收率×40 + 再生质量×30 + 经济性×30（0~1: Algorithm: recycling score = recovery rate times 40 + regeneration quality times 30 + economy times 30 (0 to 100); temperature factor = max(0.1, 1 minus max(0, temperature minus heat-resist times 0.5) / (heat-resist times 0.5) times 0.8); load factor = max(0.1, 1 minus (load / max load) squared times 0.5); corrosion factor by none/light/medium/heavy takes [1, 0.7, 0.4, 0.2]; usage factor = 4000 / annual usage hours; expected life = base life times temperature factor times load factor times corrosion factor times usage factor (lower bound 0.5 year); composite score = recycling times 0.5 + min(100, life / base life times 50) times 0.3 + corrosion-resistant times (1 minus corrosion grade times 0.2) times 100 times 0.2; greater than or equal to 75 is A, greater than or equal to 55 B, greater than or equal to 35 C, otherwise D.
map.例：碳钢（回收率 0.92、再生 0.85、经济 0.9、基准寿命 15 年、耐: Example: carbon steel (recovery rate 0.92, regeneration 0.85, economy 0.9, base life 15 years, heat-resist 400 C, max load 200 MPa, corrosion-resistant 0.3) at 60 C / 50 MPa / 4000 h / light corrosion gives recycling score 89.30, temperature factor 1, load factor 0.9688, corrosion factor 0.7, usage factor 1, expected life 10.172 years, composite 59.62 (B good). Switch to stainless steel (recovery rate 0.88, base life 25 years, heat-resist 800 C, corrosion-resistant 0.8) at 200 C / 80 MPa / 6000 h / no corrosion gives recycling 80.20, load factor 0.9488, usage factor 0.6667, life 15.813 years, composite 65.59 (B good).
map.为什么年使用小时越多寿命越短？: Why does more annual usage hours mean shorter life?
map.工具按 4000h/年 为基准折算（使用因子 = 4000/年小时），全年连续运: The tool uses 4000 h/year as the baseline (usage factor = 4000 / annual hours); running continuously 8760 h/year drops the factor to about 0.46, and life is linearly scaled by operating intensity for easy comparison across shift systems.
map.腐蚀等级怎么定？: How to determine the corrosion grade?
map.无腐蚀指干燥洁净室内；轻度为普通室内或油膜保护；中度为潮湿/偶尔接触介质；严重为: No corrosion means dry and clean indoor; light is ordinary indoor or oil-film protection; medium is humid / occasional medium contact; severe is acid-alkali salt spray environment. Each grade up drops the life factor from 1 to 0.7, 0.4, 0.2, which is a large effect; grading should be conservative.
map.关于「可回收材料评估」: About the Recyclable Material Assessment tool
map.可回收材料评估工具输入材料类型与工况条件（温度、载荷、腐蚀环境、使用时间），综合: The recyclable material assessment tool inputs material type and service conditions (temperature, load, corrosion environment, usage time), comprehensively evaluates the material recyclability score, regeneration quality, economy and expected service life, outputs a composite grade and improvement suggestions, providing a decision basis for green material selection.
map.综合回收率、再生品质、经济性多维评分: Multi-dimensional scoring of recovery rate, regeneration quality and economy
map.考虑温度、载荷、腐蚀对寿命的影响: Considers the effect of temperature, load and corrosion on life
map.输出综合等级 A-D 与选材建议: Outputs composite grade A-D and material selection suggestions
